detonate-explosive.name: Detonate Explosive
detonate-explosive.description: Detonates an alchemical grenade that is already charged, causing it to deal its damage and effects.

smoke-explosive.name: Smoke Explosive
smoke-explosive.description: Loads explosives with the effect of producing smoke when activated, upon contact with fire or on impact. The grenade produces black fog.

shock-explosive.name: Shock Explosive
shock-explosive.description: Loads explosives with alchemical energy to explode when activated, upon contact with fire or on impact.

incendiary-explosive.name: Incendiary Explosive
incendiary-explosive.description: Transforms the explosive into a sticky substance that ignites upon contact with fire and burns until extinguished.

extinguish-flames.name: Extinguish Flames
extinguish-flames.description: Extinguishes the flames of 1 x RM space.
extinguish-flames.enhance: Enhancing increases the amount of spaces by 1.

flamethrower.name: Flamethrower
flamethrower.description: Creates flames from a flamethrower as a spray explosion in front of the caster. The flamethrower can be sustained, dealing damage to anyone entering the area. The damage is applied only once, based on the position that causes the most damage.

extract-water.name: Extract Water
extract-water.description: Extracts moisture from the air and directs it to a location, which can be a container. The amount of water extracted is 1L at a hit and another 1L for every point over it. Increase or decrease DL based on available humidity.

repair-metal.name: Repair Metal
repair-metal.description: Repairs cracks in metals. Works like a cold weld, removing negative conditions from equipment.

metal-sharpening.name: Metal Sharpening
metal-sharpening.description: Performs a sharpening action on a weapon.
metal-sharpening.enhance: Enhancing gives a crit on the sharpening.

sustained-lightning.name: Sustained Lightning
sustained-lightning.description: The caster attempts to create a sustained electric arc between themselves and a target. Once the spell hits, it ends if the target leaves the spell's range or touches the caster, in which case the arc short-circuits, causing damage to both and ending the spell.

taser.name: Taser
taser.description: Charges an object of electrite with electricity that discharges on the first object it comes into contact with, adding its damage to the attack.

darken.name: Darken
darken.description: Absorbs all light entering an area, making it difficult for those outside to see what is inside. Makes anyone inside invisible to those outside, who only see a large black circle.

lasers.name: Lasers
lasers.description: Converges the rays of light from a large light source into a single point at a distance. The laser is considered a projectile.

lamp.name: Lamp
lamp.description: Lights up an alchemical torch that you can touch.

dazzling-light.name: Dazzling Light
dazzling-light.description: Produces a powerful flash that makes anyone within the area that tries to target the character disoriented if they use vision as active sense.

revealing-light.name: Revealing Light
revealing-light.description: A bluish light emanates, revealing all kinds of mysteries and invisible things. Transforms anything invisible, but corporeal within the area into something visible.

anchor-soul.name: Anchor Soul
anchor-soul.description: Anchors a creature's soul to a soul stone, preventing it from disappearing. This can be done with the souls of creatures that have been dead for up to 1 ET. If the soul is still present, resurrection is possible, but the soul will extinguish in 3 days without a body.

alter-memories.name: Alter Memories
alter-memories.description: Touches the mind of a confused person and sees the memories of the things the person is talking about. Anything said by the caster to the person will be remembered as truth.

disintegrate-mind.name: Disintegrate Mind
disintegrate-mind.description: Destroys a creature's mind permanently. Resets SPI to 0 and resets all convictions to 0. This can be done by clerics of Iskar even without having learned this ability, but the target's consent is required.

sleep.name: Sleep
sleep.description: Causes someone who is tired or exhausted to fall asleep. This is only usable in social or stealth scenes.

soothe.name: Soothe
soothe.description: A psychic attempt to soothe a target's emotions and make them less suspicious. The effect lasts until the target hits or crits in a social action or until it becomes enraged or afraid.

outcomes.miss: +3 DL to persuasion and deception against them
outcomes.graze: +2 DL to persuasion and deception against them

charm.name: Charm
charm.description: A psychic attempt to distract someone with their own thoughts.

pacify.name: Pacify
pacify.description: Allows the target to remake a morale test and get rid of afraid and enraged.

frighten.name: Frighten
frighten.description: A psychic intimidate that triggers an immediate morale test.

offend.name: Offend
offend.description: A psychic taunt that triggers an immediate morale test that makes the target enraged.

suggestion.name: Suggestion
suggestion.description: Tells a creature that can hear and understand the words and is confused, enraged, or afraid to do something, which triggers an immediate morale test. The limit actions triggered can be either the target's natural one or violent when enraged, coward when afraid and all to confused. The exact action being suggested must match the available limit actions.

overwhelming-terror.name: Overwhelming Terror
overwhelming-terror.description: Intimidates and forces an immediate morale test on all targets within range of active synesthesia or under the effect of telepathic link. They are compelled to run away from the caster on a limit stress action.

provocative-mockery.name: Provocative Mockery
provocative-mockery.description: Taunts and forces an immediate morale test on all targets within range of active synesthesia or under the effect of telepathic link. They are compelled to attack the caster on a limit stress action.

command.name: Command
command.description: Gives a simple command to a confused target. They remain Dominated until they complete the task, become unconscious, or hit or crit on a will test to break free from the domination. It is not possible to change the task without using Command again, but it is possible to specify it.

psychoactive-assistance.name: Psychoactive Assistance
psychoactive-assistance.description: Focuses on a creature with whom they share a telepathic link. The caster can make an insight or will test to resist or remove a mental status effect or psychic ability on behalf of anyone connected by a telepathic link.

psychosis.name: Psychosis
psychosis.description: Causes confusion in a target that is connected by telepathic link or possessed.

mental-paralysis.name: Mental Paralysis
mental-paralysis.description: Completely paralyzes the mind of a confused creature, rendering them immobile and fallen (unless held up by something) until they hit or crit the will test.

pain.name: Pain
pain.description: Causes a great sensation of pain to everyone connected by telepathic link.

visual-interference.name: Visual Interference
visual-interference.description: Causes blindness in a target connected by telepathic link. They redo the will test every round while the spell is sustained.

spiritual-strike.name: Spiritual Strike
spiritual-strike.description: Launches part of your soul violently at an enemy, including incorporeal ones.

outcomes.miss: stunned, -2 STA, -1 STA per 3 points under

telepathic-link.name: Telepathic Link
telepathic-link.description: Creates a telepathic link with a nearby creature, or with anyone who allows the link. The caster can speak directly to the mind of their target during the duration of the spell. The link is broken by a will test against the original DL or until the maximum distance is exceeded. It is possible to cast the spell again to affect multiple targets at the same time. Telepathic link allows casting spells that depend on it while concentrating. These spells are made against all targets affected by link simultaneously. Each simultaneous link increases the difficulty of spellcasting test by 3.

spiritual-walk.name: Spiritual Walk
spiritual-walk.description: Exits the body in spirit form, leaving it unconscious. This form has 8 AP of its own and travels in any direction with a movement speed of 6m. It is invisible and immune to any type of damage and can cast spells normally. The spirit's line of sight is equal to the basic version of the Synesthesia ability.

ghost.name: Ghost
ghost.costText: 6 AP + x STA, or 1 exhaustion out of combat
ghost.description: Generates a ghost that behaves like the spiritual walk but has limited energy. The ghost receives x STA and disappears if STA reaches 0. All memories of the ghost are lost if it does not return to the original body. The ghost loses 2 STA per turn or 1 STA if the spell is perfected.

possession.name: Possession
possession.description: Attempts to enter and possess another body during the spiritual walk or as a ghost. This is only possible if the body is confused, unconscious, or if the target allows the possession. The target is Dominated for the duration and is vulnerable to spells that require connection by telepathic link. Each time the possessed makes a will test against them, the possessor must spend 1 STA to resist. The body and the ghost occupy the same space and can act independetly. Possession ends when the possessor's STA reaches 0 or the possessed hits or crits on a will test.

torment.name: Torment
torment.description: Infects an unconscious target within range with a terrible and extremely realistic dream, which keeps the victim asleep. They can attempt to wake up every ET. The victim does not heal from this sleep and receives 2 exhaustion for each ET they remain asleep.

healing-food.name: Healing Food
healing-food.description: Modifies food to behave like a potion, giving half of its nutritional value as IL healing in the next rest. Can be used while cooking.

immune-modulation.name: Immune modulation
immune-modulation.description: Attempts to manipulate the body of a living being to metabolize poison. Allows a redo of the health test to resist poison.

reattach-limb.name: Reattach Limb
reattach-limb.description: Reattaches a limb to a body, adding a wound that requires 20 IL to be healed and function perfectly again.

clotting-touch.name: Clotting Touch
clotting-touch.description: Clots 1 point of bleeding in a target that can be touched.
clotting-touch.enhance: Enhancing increases the amount of bleeding healed by 1.

regenerate.name: Regenerate
regenerate.description: Actively manipulates the functions of a target's body to accelerate healing. Removes 4 IL or heals a wound by 4. The patient can rest during this time.
regenerate.enhance: Enhancing the spell increases the healing by 1 per enhancement.

revitalize.name: Revitalize
revitalize.description: Performs a ritual to revive a creature within reach of the body, as long as the body is in a condition to be alive and there is a sample of the soul nearby. The body is revived with all its wounds and IL damage. IL defaults to 49 if it were 50 or higher.

enhanced-sleep.name: Enhanced Sleep
enhanced-sleep.description: Blesses the sleep up to 10 creatures for 4 hours, allowing everyone except the caster to receive +2 to the health skill for resting and to complete it in 1 ET.

preserve-corpse.name: Preserve Corpse
preserve-corpse.description: Prevents decomposition from affecting a corpse or part of it for a full day.

remodel-face.name: Remodel face
remodel-face.description: Change your face. On a crit, looks exactly like someone else. On a hit, can choose to gain the mutation Beautiful or Ugly. On a graze, become ugly. On a miss, become ugly and irrecognizable.
remodel-face.enhance: Enhancing allows doing it on someone else.

command-dead.name: Command Dead
command-dead.description: Commands animated dead. The command is free and the corpse will attempt do it to the best of its ability.
command-dead.enhance: Can be enhanced, to control 1 additional corpse per enhancement.

animate-dead.name: Animate Dead
animate-dead.description: Animates a corpse with a soul fragment. It can only move and attack or grapple enemies. The corpse retains its strength, size, and resilience. If out of combat, it is possible to attempt to speak with the undead. If the brain and vocal cords are intact, it can answer some questions.

tree-house.name: Tree House
tree-house.description: Grows trees and shapes them to have enough hollow space inside to serve as a room. The effect of the spell is permanent, but it takes the cost duration of the spell to shape the trees. The internal space is equal to 6 cubic meters xRM.

accelerate-blooming.name: Accelerate Blooming
accelerate-blooming.description: The plant will go through its seasonal stages very quickly, draining nutrients and water from the soil and bearing fruit if possible. The yield depends on the plant.

defoliate.name: Defoliate
defoliate.description: Causes all deciduous trees in the area to lose their leaves within 1 round. The leaves are flammable.

insect-pheromone.name: Insect Pheromone
insect-pheromone.description: Secretes pheromone, which can be stored. Causes nearby insects to swarm anyone that gets in contact with it and sting them. The effects depend on the insects that are present and how long they will take to arrive. In combat, it works if there are insects within 50m, they arrive in the next round.

stimulate-secretion.name: Stimulate Secretion
stimulate-secretion.description: Forces a dead venomous animal to secrete venom. The venom produced is sufficient for 10 applications and the effect depends on the corpse used.

clone.name: Clone
clone.description: Converts the genes of a part of the body of a preserved corpse to match those of another creature of the same species. A living sample of the model must be present.

aurora.name: Aurora
aurora.description: Draws or writes a simple and blurred message in the sky that can be seen at night within the spell's range.

call-lightning.name: Call Lightning
call-lightning.description: Summons a lightning bolt to a specific target within the electrical storm as a projectile.

storm-of-lightning.name: Storm of Lightning
storm-of-lightning.description: Focuses lightning from a thunderstorm into a small area. Every beginning of round, a lightning falls on anyone in the area.

freeze-water.name: Freeze Water
freeze-water.description: Freezes water in an area after one round. A puddle becomes slippery, turning into difficult terrain with a balance DL of 12. A layer of ice 10 cm thick is created on a water surface, but additional layers can be added if there is enough water. The temperature of the ice increases due to its freezing, causing it to start melting immediately.

create-fog.name: Create Fog
create-fog.description: Condenses water in the air over a large area, creating a thick fog that hinders visibility. The fog stays until blown away or the combat ends.

rain.name: Rain
rain.description: If there are enough clouds, converts them to a location and makes it rain there, soaking everything. Crits can cause hail to fall, dealing damage every round.

landslide.name: Landslide
landslide.description: Heats and cools a solid, causing expansion and contraction in adjacent planes of the solid, causing it to break. This technique works well on crystalline structures, rocks, and especially wet soil. One round later, it triggers a landslide or snow that damages anyone still in the area.

strong-wind.name: Strong Wind
strong-wind.description: Produces an entropic field that facilitates the movement of wind in one direction, causing a strong gust. Removes fog, smoke and dust.
